brand.note: Rebrandable: written to <html> as --brand from config/brand.ts. Never carries white text; never used as text.

on-brand.note: Text and icons on saffron (10.75:1). Rebrandable as onBrand.

brand-soft.note: Unselected order bump, avatar disc, pending status pills, selection. Rebrandable as brandSoft.

brand-ink.note: Text on Saffron Cream (5.41:1). Rebrandable as brandInk.

sale.note: Discounted current price only, plus errors and cancelled status. 4.82:1 on white.

ok.note: "Bepul" free delivery, toast check, delivering status. 5.40:1 on white.

ink.note: Primary text, focus ring, count badge.

ink-2.note: Secondary text, struck old prices, inactive nav. 5.24:1 on white, 4.76:1 on ground.

ground.note: Page ground; equals brand.chrome, the Telegram header and background colour.

surface.note: Cards, sheets, bottom bar, toast, add button.

tile.note: Behind food photos; input fill, secondary button, neutral stepper, icon wells.

track.note: Switch off track and scrollbar thumb (--track in globals.css).

display.purpose: "Rahmat!" on the success screen; story titles at 34px.

headline.purpose: Home greeting and page titles; onboarding titles at 30px.

title.purpose: Product name in the sheet; 22px sheet headings, 21px hero headline.

section.purpose: Section heads on home and cart; profile name.

subsection.purpose: Headings inside sheets and profile; "Jami" label.

body.purpose: Base text and descriptions; inputs at 16px.

item.purpose: Product names on cards (two-line clamp), bump text.

button.purpose: Button labels, sentence case; 16px large, 13px small.

caption.purpose: Category tile labels, fact chips, status pills.

price.purpose: Card prices; proportional numerals on purpose (Onest tabular "1" splits numbers).

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Floating cart bar and toast: things that hover over scrolling content.

shadows.name: thumb
shadows.purpose: Small controls on photos or tracks: add button, live stepper, switch knob, sheet handle, photo close buttons, active language segment.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The only easing curve; every transition and keyframe uses it (sheet close uses ease-in for 200ms).

motion.name: pop-in
motion.purpose: "+" becoming the stepper, count badges, success check disc.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Toast, cart rows, re-filtered catalog grid.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Backdrops, cart bar total change, story images.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Press feedback: 0.9 icon buttons, 0.97 tiles, 0.98 buttons, 0.985 cart bar.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion collapses all animation and transition durations.

platform.note: TelegramProvider calls setHeaderColor and setBackgroundColor with brand.chrome (Bot API 6.9+); viewport themeColor is brand.chrome. No dark tokens exist.

narrative.overview:
The app is a calm, premium delivery counter that sets the food out and gets out of the way. It is the category standard played straight, at the craft level of Yandex Eda and Uzum Tezkor / Express24. Food photography and prices lead. Chrome recedes into a warm-grey ground, white cards with no outlines, near-black type and one saffron colour that marks the thing to press. The whole flow is built for a hungry person ordering one-handed inside Telegram: find food by chips or search, tap "+", watch it turn into a stepper in place, watch the floating cart bar update, confirm in one tap.

Density is comfortable and phone-first, inside a single 512px column. The type is one face, Onest, set in sentence case at three weights. Depth is tonal: white on warm grey, with photographs sitting on soft grey tiles. Shadows appear only under things that genuinely float. Motion is an expo ease-out. Sheets rise, the stepper pops in where the "+" was, the cart bar slides up, and nothing bounces.

The app is always light, including inside Telegram's dark mode, because the user asked for no black surfaces. The Telegram header and WebView background are painted the same warm grey as the ground (`brand.chrome`, #F4F4F2), so the app reads as stitched into Telegram rather than framed by it. Identity is four tokens in `config/brand.ts` (brand, on-brand, brand-soft, brand-ink), which restaurants rebrand. Three earlier worlds are rejected and survive only as anti-references. **"The White Plate on Red"** was a red reference look: a loud #f00000 field, green circular add buttons, red rounded-square steppers, Red Hat Display / Manrope type, pink blush offer cards and food on white plates. **Pop** used a cream ground, a mustard accent, Rubik caps, 2px brown outlines and hard stamps. **Atlas Silk** was ornamental and traditional.
keyCharacteristics: Always light: a warm-grey ground (#f4f4f2) and white cards in every Telegram theme, with no dark tokens.
One saffron brand fill with ink text on it, reserved for the primary action, the cart bar, the live stepper and the current selection.
Red appears only as a discounted current price (and errors), and green only as "Bepul" free delivery and success.
Food is shown in rounded photo tiles on soft grey, and prices sit above names.
A white "+" on the photo morphs into a saffron stepper in place, and a floating saffron cart bar sits above the labelled bottom nav.
One discount signal: a red current price plus a struck grey old price, with no percentage badges.
Onest Variable for Latin and Cyrillic, at weights 400 / 500 / 600 only, in sentence case.
Only two shadows, for floating elements and small controls. Motion is expo ease-out, and nothing bounces.

rules.name: The Single Saffron Rule
rules.body: Saffron is the one colour that says "press this" or "this is chosen". Use it for the main action, the cart bar, the live stepper and the selected state, and nowhere else. Ink is always the text on top of it.

rules.name: The Red Means Cheaper Rule
rules.body: Red appears on a price only when that price is discounted, always paired with the struck old price in Graphite. Outside prices, red is reserved for errors and cancelled orders.

rules.name: The Green Means Done Rule
rules.body: Green appears only for free delivery and for success (the toast check, the delivering status). It is never used for an action button.

rules.name: The Always Light Rule
rules.body: There is one theme. No `.dark` class, no `dark:` variants, no dark tokens. The app paints Counter Grey and white even in Telegram's dark mode, and Telegram's header and background are set to `brand.chrome`.

rules.name: The Four Tokens Rule
rules.body: A restaurant rebrands by editing `config/brand.ts` only. Brand, on-brand, brand-soft and brand-ink must keep on-brand and brand-ink at 4.5:1 or better against their grounds.

rules.name: The Proportional Price Rule
rules.body: Every price, total and count uses the `price` utility, which applies proportional numerals plus -0.01em tracking. This is deliberate: Onest's tabular "1" is wide enough to split numbers ("1 79 000"), so tabular figures are never switched on.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: Use only 400, 500 and 600. Emphasis comes from size, ink versus Graphite, and saffron, never from bold or black weights.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Buttons, chips, tabs and headings are sentence case. There are no uppercase labels, eyebrows or letter-spaced kickers.

rules.name: The Only-What-Floats Rule
rules.body: Cards, banners, tiles, chips, inputs and the bottom bar have no shadow. Float is for things that hover above scrolling content; Thumb is for small controls sitting on a photo or a track.

rules.name: The Tone-Not-Stroke Rule
rules.body: A card on the ground never carries an outline. Hairlines appear only as dividers inside a white surface (list rows, the totals rule, the sheet footer, the bottom bar's top edge, and the trust panel inside the product sheet). A coloured border is a state: ink at 70% on a focused field, red on an errored field, saffron on the selected order bump and payment radio.

dos: **Do** put saffron (#ffc21a by default, from `config/brand.ts`) only on the primary action, the cart bar, the live stepper and the selected state, always with Saffron Ink-on (#1c1a14) text.
**Do** separate surfaces by tone: white (#ffffff) cards on Counter Grey (#f4f4f2), and photos on Photo Tile (#f1f0ec).
**Do** show a discount as a red current price (#d92d27) plus a struck Graphite old price, and show full prices in ink.
**Do** set every price, total and count in the `price` utility with proportional numerals.
**Do** use the white "+" that morphs in place into a saffron pill stepper, and keep the floating cart bar visible whenever the cart has items.
**Do** use Lucide line icons (1.75–2.25 stroke) and the labelled four-tab bottom bar.
**Do** keep type at Onest 400 / 500 / 600, in sentence case.
**Do** reserve the Float shadow for the cart bar and toast, and the Thumb shadow for small controls on photos or tracks.
**Do** animate with expo ease-out only: sheets rise, steppers and badges pop, lists rise 10px.
**Do** paint Telegram's header and background with `brand.chrome` (#F4F4F2) and stay light in every Telegram theme.
**Do** show only the promises a restaurant has switched on in `brand.ts`.
donts: **Don't** add a dark theme, `.dark` tokens or `dark:` variants, or use black as a surface. The user asked for no black.
**Don't** put white text on saffron, or use saffron as a text colour. Use Saffron Ink on Saffron Cream instead.
**Don't** add "−20%" badges, ribbons or percentage tags. The red price and struck old price are the single discount signal.
**Don't** use red for anything but a discounted current price, errors and cancelled status, and don't use green for anything but free delivery and success.
**Don't** outline cards on the ground, or add shadows to cards, banners, chips or the bottom bar.
**Don't** switch prices to tabular figures. Onest's tabular "1" splits numbers.
**Don't** use bold or black weights, uppercase labels, eyebrows or letter-spaced kickers.
**Don't** show star ratings or review counts on products. No real ones exist.
**Don't** use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
**Don't** let anything bounce, overshoot or spring.
**Don't** return to "The White Plate on Red": no #f00000 red field, green circular add buttons, red square steppers, pink blush cards, food on white plates, or Red Hat Display / Manrope.
**Don't** return to Pop (cream ground, mustard accent, Rubik caps, 2px brown outlines, hard stamps) or to Atlas Silk (ornamental, traditional, silk-pattern decoration).
